script: Nazi soldiers once found a mass grave in a forest, and blamed the wrong country for thirty five years. In 1943, German troops digging in the Katyn forest uncovered thousands of bodies in Polish military uniforms. Germany accused the Soviet Union of the killings. The Soviets denied it, and blamed the Nazis instead. For decades, the official story stayed frozen exactly there, repeated in schoolbooks on both sides of the Iron Curtain. Then in 1990, under a new Soviet leader trying to open old files, investigators found the real orders. Joseph Stalin himself had signed the execution list in 1940, before the Nazis ever reached that forest. Nearly twenty two thousand Polish officers had been shot by Soviet secret police, and blamed on someone else for thirty five years. Nazi soldiers once found a mass grave in a forest, and the whole world blamed the wrong country for thirty five years.

title: Nazis Found a Mass Grave, and Blamed the Wrong Country
description:
In 1943, German troops discovered thousands of executed Polish officers in the Katyn forest. The USSR denied it and blamed the Nazis for 35 years, until Gorbachev admitted the truth in 1990.
